checks_passed: MIT choices show sizes and smallest default without loading weights
explicit selection reaches engine with its own pins and resource minimum; controls lock while loading
ready state and exported report identify the loaded model
iPad and narrow layouts keep prompt/Send directly below response window and above expanded source import
Send streams a plain-text reply, escapes transcript text and blocks duplicate sends
Enter sends the next message with prior chat context
AI Build proposes a collection and real MPLPB creates it only after review
disposed generation invalidates readiness, keeps original diagnostic and offers reload while source engine remains available
switch revokes old provider and reloads with persisted selection before another allocation
unavailable saved selection recovers to smallest default
non-MIT catalog disables AI loading while real source engine remains usable
